episodes.title: 2026 Census: What you need to know to ensure you’re counted - Lakkoofsa Ummataa Australia (Census): Lakkoofsa keessa jiraachuuf maal beekuu qabdu- Australia Explained
episodes.description: The 2026 Census is on Tuesday 11 August and every person in Australia on this night must be counted. Census data is used to understand where we live, the languages we use at home (including Auslan), the support we need and how Australia is changing as a nation. Being counted helps ensure your community, culture and beliefs are represented. Here’s what you need to know about completing the Census for your household. - Lakkoofsi ummataa(Census) bara 2026 Kibxata(Tuesday) Hagayya (August) 11 yoo ta’u namni halkan kana Australia keessa jiru hundi lakkaa’amuu qaba. Daataan lakkoofsa ummataa bakka jiraatnu, afaanota mana keessatti dubbatnu (Auslan dabalatee), deeggarsa nu barbaachisu fi akkaataa biyyai Australia akka sabaatti jijjiiramaa jirtu hubachuuf kan gargaaru dha. Lakkaa’amuun hawaasni kee, aadaan kee fi amantaan kee bakka bu’ummaa akka qabaatu gargaara. Waa’ee Lakkoofsa Ummataa mana keessaniif xumuruu wanti beekuu qabdan kunooti.

episodes.title: The Torres Strait Islander Flag: Land, Sea and People - Torres Strait Islander: Alaabaa, Dachee, Glaanaa fi Ummata - Australia Explained
episodes.description: In Australia, you might see three flags flying together: the Australian National Flag, the Aboriginal Flag and the Torres Strait Islander Flag. Aboriginal peoples and Torres Strait Islander peoples are the two distinct Indigenous peoples of Australia, each with their own histories, cultures, languages and flag. For many Torres Strait Islander people, the flag is a powerful symbol of identity and belonging, whether they live on the islands, the mainland or overseas. - Australia keessatti tarii alaabaa gosa sadii waliin balali'an agartan taha.? Alaabaa Biyyaalessaa Australia, Alaabaa Aboriginal fi Alaabaa Torres Strait islander. ummattootni Aboriginal fi Torres Strait Islander ummattoota adda addaa Abbootii Dachee Australia ti, Lachanuu seenaa, aadaa, afaanii fi alaabaa ofii qabu.
